name: Li Xing
current_role: Chairman, Huanlejia Food Group Co., Ltd. (Shenzhen ChiNext: 300997)
profile: Li Xing (b. 1971) founded Huanlejia in Zhanjiang, Guangdong in 2001 and remains chairman and co-controlling shareholder. The company began with canned fruit, seafood and quail-egg tins, and from 2014 built its 'Huanlejia' raw-pressed coconut juice into its biggest product line. It listed on ChiNext in 2021.
interesting_fact: Huanlejia moved into plant-protein drinks in 2014 when its canned-food niche plateaued; its coconut juice became the company's largest revenue source, alongside fruit canning.
notes: Company bio: Chinese national with HK permanent residence, founded company 2001. Day-to-day leadership has passed to vice-chairman/president Li Zihao (from March 2025). The IR email is the board secretary's office; best route is via IR. No personal media presence found.

name: Wen Hongfu
current_role: Chairman, General Manager and CTO, Guangdong Omat Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. (Shanghai STAR: 688530)
profile: Wen Hongfu (aged ~61) is the founder and co-controlling shareholder (with Fang Hong and Wen Ya) of Omat (欧莱新材), a maker of high-performance sputtering targets for flat-panel displays, integrated circuits and solar. Omat listed on the STAR Market in May 2024. He also runs its subsidiaries making high-purity metals and indium products.
interesting_fact: Omat's shares opened 176% above their 9.60-yuan offer price on their STAR Market debut on 9 May 2024. Sputtering targets are a key material in semiconductor and display fabs, a supply chain China has been trying to localise.
deep_cut_fact: Before he became an entrepreneur, Wen was a university teacher at Anhui Institute of Technology (formerly Huainan Mining Institute). He then worked at China National Metals & Minerals Import & Export's Shenzhen trading arm and was assistant GM of Guangdong Metallurgical Shenzhen Import & Export Co.
notes: The Hurun source name 'Omat' is Guangdong Omat Advanced Materials (欧莱新材). He is also the CTO, so the company is a semiconductor-materials angle that may suit the podcast.

name: Yuan Qinshan
current_role: Chairman, Dayun Group Co., Ltd. (Shanxi); vice-president, Shanxi General Chamber of Commerce
profile: Yuan Qinshan (b. March 1968, Yuncheng, Shanxi) started selling motorcycles in 1987, then built the Dayun/Dayang motorcycle bases (up to 1.5m bikes a year) and from 2004 Dayun heavy trucks. Dayun is now a private commercial-vehicle group moving into EVs; it launched the premium NEV brand Yuanhang in 2023.
interesting_fact: Dayun motorcycles were the exclusive motorcycle supplier to the 2008 Beijing Olympics, and Yuan was named a National Model Worker in 2015.
deep_cut_fact: At 18, Yuan borrowed money from relatives and went to Guangzhou to buy a Jialing 70 motorcycle for 2,000 yuan. He rode it about 1,800 km home to Yuncheng over six days and five nights, sold it for 3,500 yuan, and later got other village youths into the same trade.
notes: Dayun is private (not listed), so there is no IR channel. Baidu Baike notes that some of his company equity stakes were frozen in 2025, which suggests financial strain at the group. Approach through the Dayun Group corporate office or Yuanhang Auto PR. Also covered by zh.wikipedia: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E8%BF%9C%E5%8B%A4%E5%B1%B1

name: Ruth Chapman
current_role: Co-founder and former co-CEO/joint chair of MATCHESFASHION (exited; the business went into administration in 2024)
profile: Ruth Chapman OBE (b. 1961, Wirral) and her husband Tom opened a single boutique in Wimbledon in 1987. They grew it into the global luxury e-tailer MATCHESFASHION.COM, launching the website in 2007. They stepped back to joint chairs in 2015 and sold to Apax in 2017 in a deal valuing the company at over $1bn.
interesting_fact: After the 2007 website launch, which she has called a 'seismic moment', the business grew by up to 100% a year. It ended up selling 450+ brands to 176 countries, with 95% of sales online.
deep_cut_fact: Before Matches she worked at Jaeger, at Harrods and at a video production company. She met Tom at 21, and he persuaded her to leave her job to help run his fashion boutique. From 2013 to 2017 she sat on the British Fashion Council's NEWGEN panel scouting young designers.
notes: Appointed OBE in 2020 with Tom, and they won the 2017 Drapers Lifetime Achievement award. Tom co-founded the homeware platform Abask (2022), which may be a route to the couple. No personal published contact found.

name: The Ives family
current_role: Family owners of Rainham Steel Co. Ltd (Rainham, Essex) and associated property companies; founder Bill Ives died in 2017
profile: Family fortune founded by William 'Bill' Ives (1943-2017), who set up Rainham Steel in April 1973. It is now one of the UK's leading independent structural-steel stockholders, with a 70-acre distribution hub in Scunthorpe. The business has expanded into industrial and commercial property investment through two property companies.
interesting_fact: Rainham Steel's Scunthorpe hub was chosen for its closeness to the British Steel mills and the docks. It stocks over 100,000 tonnes of structural steel and runs its own fleet of about 50 HGVs.
deep_cut_fact: Founder Bill Ives was a former boxer. Promoter Frank Warren published a personal tribute to him after his death in 2017.
notes: The patriarch has died (Wikipedia: 12 Oct 1943 - 31 Aug 2017), so the entry is the family/heirs. No family member is publicly named as a spokesperson, and the only published email is a general sales inbox. The holding entity is Ives Family Holdings Ltd (Companies House). Avoid Bill Ives's Wikipedia controversies in any outreach.

name: Susumu Fujita
current_role: Representative Director & Chairman, CyberAgent, Inc. (since Dec 2025); also President of AbemaTV, Inc. and CEO of Zelvia (FC Machida Zelvia)
profile: Susumu Fujita (b. 1973, Sabae, Fukui) founded CyberAgent in 1998 as an internet-ad agency and took it public on TSE Mothers in 2000, aged 26. He built it into a media, ad-tech and games group including Cygames and the streaming service ABEMA. He handed the presidency to Takahiro Yamauchi in December 2025 and remains chairman and a minority shareholder.
interesting_fact: He is a top racehorse owner. His Forever Young became the first Japanese-bred and trained horse to win the Breeders' Cup Classic (2025) and the first to win back-to-back Saudi Cups (2026).
deep_cut_fact: Fujita is a serious mahjong player. He trained at Shoichi Sakurai's Jankikai as a student and once considered turning pro, and in December 2014 he won the Mahjong Saikyosen title, announcing it on his own blog. He later founded the M.League pro mahjong league.
notes: Very public founder: he writes the long-running blog 'Shibuya de hataraku shacho' and has authored about 10 books, including 'Confessions of a President Working in Shibuya' (2005). Good angles are AI/ad-tech and ABEMA. CyberAgent also runs its own LLM and AI research lab.

name: James Richard Belardi
current_role: Co-Founder, Executive Chairman & CIO, Athene; Founder, Chairman & CEO, Apollo Insurance Solutions Group; board member, Apollo Global Management
profile: Jim Belardi co-founded Athene in 2009 and was CEO until 2025, growing it into a retirement-services insurer with nearly $400bn in assets (merged into Apollo in 2022). Earlier he was President of SunAmerica Life and EVP/CIO of AIG Retirement Services. He is now Athene's executive chairman and CIO.
interesting_fact: Athene, which he built, is the annuity and insurance engine behind Apollo's 'retirement services' model. Its insurance balance sheet funds much of Apollo's private-credit origination.
deep_cut_fact: Belardi is an elite swimmer: he swam in the 1976 and 1980 US Olympic Trials and is a nine-time Masters Swimming world record holder. He also sits on the board of Southern California Aquatics and chairs the investment committee of Paulist Productions.
notes: Stanford BA (economics) and UCLA MBA. Apollo's people page: https://www.apollo.com/about-apollo/our-people/jim-belardi . The best route is Athene External Relations or Apollo media relations.

name: Shen Yanan
current_role: Founder, Habit 栖息地 AI smart-home brand (operating company 楠社科技 / Nanshe Technology); former co-founder & president of Li Auto
profile: Shen Yanan ('Kevin') was Li Auto's employee No. 2 and first co-founder, and he served as president from 2015 until he resigned at the start of 2023. Before that he was a Lenovo vice president running global supply chain. He then founded the AI smart-home brand Habit (栖息地), backed by Li Auto. It raised RMB 653m early on and a RMB 700m Series A in August 2026.
interesting_fact: Li Auto led the Pre-A round of his smart-home start-up, making it one of the first ventures by a former executive that the carmaker invested in directly. The August 2026 Series A of RMB 700m was reported as the largest home-furnishing industry financing in China's primary market in three years.
deep_cut_fact: Before Li Auto he was a Lenovo vice president responsible for global supply chain operations. He joined Li Xiang as president in November 2015, responsible for overall strategy, business development and supply chain management.
notes: He exited Li Auto's shareholder register (Beijing CHJ) in July 2023. The current venture is an AI/embodied-intelligence 'smart residence' business with a global HQ and R&D centre planned in Changzhou, so there is a possible energy and home-AI angle. No personal channels found; approach via Habit/栖息地 PR.

name: Lin Congyin
current_role: Chairman, Joeone Co., Ltd. (九牧王, Shanghai: 601566); special vice-president, China National Garment Association
profile: Lin Congyin founded menswear brand Joeone in Jinjiang, Fujian in the mid-1980s, specialising in men's trousers, and earned the nickname 'king of Chinese trousers'. Joeone listed in Shanghai in 2011. He remains chairman and controlling shareholder, with the company also investing in other fashion brands.
interesting_fact: Joeone won exclusive mainland rights to 'Masha Wang' fabric and sold more than 4 million pairs of trousers between June 1995 and end-1996, passing 100m yuan in sales.
deep_cut_fact: In 1985, with just 200 yuan in his pocket, Lin went to Jiujiang in Jiangxi selling zippers. That is where he saw the opportunity in clothing retail. The next year he used his zipper savings plus 18,000 yuan borrowed to start a garment factory back in Jinjiang.
notes: Before founding Joeone he left a state grain-bureau job in 1984. Route via IR/board office.

name: Ling Hui
current_role: Shareholder and person acting in concert with her husband Xia Jun, controller of Guangdong Create Century Intelligent Equipment Group (300083.SZ)
profile: Ling Hui is the wife and acting-in-concert party of Xia Jun, chairman and GM of Create Century (创世纪), a Shenzhen/Dongguan maker of CNC machine tools and drilling/tapping centres for 3C electronics and general industry. Her wealth (listed jointly with Xia Jun) comes from their stake in the company. She does not appear to hold an executive role.
interesting_fact: Create Century's CNC machining centres are widely used to make smartphone and laptop casings. Xia Jun began as a salesman at Zhuhai Beisuite before running Shenzhen Create Century Machinery from 2005.
notes: Private, non-executive; media coverage of her is limited to share-sale disclosures (e.g. 2024 reduction, per NBD https://www.nbd.com.cn/articles/2025-02-26/3767697.html). Better to approach Xia Jun via company IR.
